name: Cry Sweeper
source:
A series of mysterious events has occurred in a seemingly normal high school somewhere in Japan. Girls have been reported missing or assaulted under mysterious circumstances. The police is helpless. Two people are determined to solve the mystery: Kai Shura, a man who can read minds and recall events from the past, and Ami Kanko, a girl who controls the powers of telekinesis. Will they ever be able to get to the bottom of the things, or will gruesome events continue to happen amidst innocent teenagers?..

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cry-sweeper]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
日本某地一所看似普通的高中接连发生神秘事件，不断有女生在蹊跷的情况下失踪或遇袭，警方对此束手无策。两个人决心揭开谜底：能够读取心灵、重现往事的修罗魁，以及能够操纵念动力的少女阿弥坎子。他们究竟能否查清真相，还是残酷事件仍会继续降临在无辜的少年少女身上？

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cry-sweeper]Moby Games[/url]]
